title: Slides
lead: Maintain published collections for banners, carousels, products and testimonials while templates own the visual structure.

sections.title: Build a collection
body: Create a collection and select its content type. Add images, titles, text and links, then arrange the items and enable only those ready for display.
The image picker browses the public Images upload area. Keep alternative text useful and avoid embedding text that should remain editable inside images.

sections.title: Assign and insert
body: Choose a location discovered from the active template manifest and publish the collection. A location must accept the collection content type.
Use a typed page block, a legacy Slides marker or the shared component service. The modern service provides published item data to the chosen registered component format.

sections.title: Motion and recovery
body: Autoplay starts disabled. When enabled, use a suitable interval and template controls that support pause, keyboard navigation and reduced motion.
History and Trash preserve recovery. Missing template locations produce administrative warnings without deleting assignments.

sections.title: Raw slide collections
body: slides:data(key: active-template location key) returns name, contentType, type, autoplay, interval and items: id, title, text, image, alt, href, label, attribution, price. Only live published collections and enabled matching items are returned. Template/filter rules still apply. slides:location remains compatible with existing card partials.

Bind slides:data as promotion. Example: {{#promotion.items}}{{/promotion.items}}. The plugin supplies data; the template supplies accessible carousel controls, CSS and JavaScript. No script may be authored inside the HTML editor.
